text: Twenty-three fifty. [pause] Ten kilometres away, the city is asleep.
Then every phone buzzes at once. [pause] Emergency alert. [pause] Stay inside.
Two hundred metres. [pause] You don't see it yet. [pause] You feel it.
A T. rex footprint was almost a metre long. [pause] Every step would send a small shock through the ground… and the puddles start to ripple.
Fifty metres. [pause] Car alarms go off, one by one.
It may smell you, more than it sees you. [pause] Its sense of smell was one of the best of any dinosaur.
And then… it simply walks on.
Six o'clock. [pause] Sunrise. [pause] Only its footprints are left in the street.
For sixty-six million years, one rock decided who would rule this planet.
So tell me… if that rock had missed, do you think we would ever have stood a chance?
